GAOSHOU_RELIC_GAOSHOU_AMULET.title: Master's Amulet
GAOSHOU_RELIC_GAOSHOU_AMULET.description: 3 times per turn: when you spend {Energy:energyIcons()}, gain 1 {Stars:starIcons()}; when you spend {Stars:starIcons()}, gain 1 {Energy:energyIcons()}.
GAOSHOU_RELIC_GAOSHOU_AMULET.flavor: The finest techniques know how to borrow strength.
GAOSHOU_RELIC_ADAPTIVE_CAPACITOR.title: Adaptive Capacitor
GAOSHOU_RELIC_ADAPTIVE_CAPACITOR.descrip: At end of turn, if your remaining {Energy:energyIcons()} exceeds your max Energy, raise your max Energy by 1.
GAOSHOU_RELIC_CAROUSEL.title: Carousel
GAOSHOU_RELIC_CAROUSEL.description: Each turn, when you play the 3rd [gold]Temporary[/gold] card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}{Stars:starIcons()}.
GAOSHOU_RELIC_TRASH_CAN.title: Trash Can
GAOSHOU_RELIC_TRASH_CAN.description: Every 3 turns, add 1 random [gold]Waste[/gold] card to your hand.
GAOSHOU_RELIC_SHREDDER.title: Shredder
GAOSHOU_RELIC_SHREDDER.description: You can remove cards at Rest Sites.
GAOSHOU_RELIC_SANDEVISTAN.title: Sandevistan
GAOSHOU_RELIC_SANDEVISTAN.description: Whenever you are about to lose [gold]Temporary Strength[/gold] or [gold]Temporary Dexterity[/gold], lose only 1 stack, then lose 1 HP.
GAOSHOU_RELIC_MARTIAL_ARTS_MANUAL.title: Martial Arts Manual
GAOSHOU_RELIC_MARTIAL_ARTS_MANUAL.descri: Whenever you spend {Energy:energyIcons()}, gain 1 [gold]Temporary Dexterity[/gold]. Whenever you spend {Stars:starIcons()}, gain 1 [gold]Temporary Strength[/gold].
GAOSHOU_RELIC_BATTLE_PASS.title: Battle Pass
GAOSHOU_RELIC_BATTLE_PASS.description: After each combat, lose 15 [gold]Gold[/gold] and gain an extra card reward.
GAOSHOU_RELIC_WHEELCHAIR.title: Wheelchair
GAOSHOU_RELIC_WHEELCHAIR.description:
At the start of your turn, gain 3 {Stars:starIcons()}.
You may pay with 2 {Stars:starIcons()} instead of 1 {Energy:energyIcons()}.
